children: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) surged on record $96B revenue and booming data‑center demand while expanding AI reach—buying Hugging Face, deploying Vera Rubin at hyperscalers, holding massive AI stakes, facing a DOJ probe, and drawing bullish analyst and partner deployments amid margin and memory cost warnings.
Previous Week Recap
NVIDIA Revenue Jump, Forecasts
: NVIDIA (NVDA) posted $96B quarterly revenue, up 106% YOY; data center sales were $89B. Company forecasts $108B next-quarter revenue and warns of high memory costs and margin pressure.
DOJ Antitrust Probe Expanded
: DOJ opened and expanded an antitrust probe into NVIDIA’s multi‑billion licensing deal with Groq (reported $17–$20B). DOJ issued an information request; fines possible, unwind seen unlikely.
NVIDIA Buys Hugging Face
: NVIDIA agreed to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9B, adding a major AI model platform to NVDA’s software and developer tools portfolio; CEO comments were cited.
Vera Rubin Deployments For OpenAI
: NVIDIA’s Vera Rubin processors will be deployed at scale by Firmus in Asia-Pacific data centers for OpenAI. Firmus capacity exceeds 900 MW; first gigawatt of OpenAI deployments targeted H2 2026.
Private Portfolio Valuation
: NVIDIA held an estimated $48B private portfolio as of July 26: about $30B in OpenAI, up to $10B in Anthropic, $5B Safe Superintelligence, plus smaller AI stakes and a $1.5B SB Energy pledge.
Cantor Positive On NVIDIA

: Cantor Fitzgerald keeps Overweight on NVIDIA (NVDA) with $350 target, citing strong AI infrastructure demand, supply constraints, and NVDA as TSMC’s biggest customer; notes relatively low valuation.
Vera Rubin Launch Pricing
: NVIDIA (NVDA) launched Vera Rubin AI infrastructure at about $40,000 per unit vs ~$25,000 for Blackwell and ~$18,000 for Hopper, shifting to sell integrated stacks instead of standalone GPUs.
H100 Rental Rates Rise
: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said three‑year‑old H100 GPU rental rates jumped 22% in one month to $3.28/hour, calling NVIDIA compute resources tradable, durable and valuable to rent.
Kalshi Plans NVDA Contract
: Kalshi intends to offer a 24/7 perpetual contract on NVIDIA (NVDA) providing leveraged, no-expiry exposure; launch requires SEC and CFTC approval due to dual regulatory oversight.
Major NVDA Deployment Plans
: Partners plan major NVDA deployments: IREN to use NVIDIA DSX across an 800 MW Bundey campus; Sharon AI targets up to 68,000 NVIDIA GPUs; data centers and Atlassian readied for accelerated compute.
